LESSON: WRITING 3.3.1 DRAWING AND COLOURING PICTURES.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Writing 3.3.1 Drawing and colouring pictures.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.3.1 Drawing and colouring pictures., part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which things are found in our school? 2. What tools are used for drawing and colouring? 3. How do we hold our books and pencils/pens when drawing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.3.1 Drawing and colouring pictures. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination:Exploration as learner draws and colour things found in the school environment.

• Self-efficacy:learner understands self as they an independently draw and colour.

Values:
• Unity: Cooperation as learner shares drawings and colouring tools with others in class.

• Peace: patience as learner practices sharing the available drawing and colouring tools.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Social cohesion as learner works together with others to draw and colour.

Link to other Activity Areas:

● Learner relates naming things found in school with naming things found in the environment in Environmental

Activities.

● Creative Activities (Art and Craft) as learner draw, colour and model different things in the same way they draw,

colour and model different things found in school.

Suggested Learning Resources: pictures of things found within the school environment, pencils, colour pencil, realia,

mosaic material
